detailed_descriptions.en: Become a Legend with the Hunting Pack DLC We've prepared something perfect for the hunters out there. The Hunting Pack DLC adds a collection of beautifully adorned weapons and new outfits for your character, letting you express the wild spirit dwelling inside you. Hunt down legendary animals, forge your gear from their spoils, and enter the forest looking every inch the master hunter you were born to be. Key Features New attire Choose between two outfits to clothe yourself and embrace your passion for hunting. This unique apparel is crafted from rare materials like fur, leather, and feathers taken from legendary animals. Blend into the forest with paw-like shoes and special headwear, or show your prestige in a fox scarf and gloves embellished with feathers. Adorned weaponry Carry a bow adorned with glossy feathers, a spear finished with vivid plumage, a knife wrapped in sturdy leather, and a crossbow accented with details made of scales. Every piece is shaped from a hard-won trophy, turning each hunt into something you'll want by your side on every trip. How It Works The DLC content is available immediately after purchase. To obtain new goods (outfits and weapons), you will have to hunt legendary animals coming with the Wild Game update and then craft new items. When playing co-op, everyone in the session will gain access to the DLC content, provided that the host has the pack installed. Please note that if the host does not own the DLC, the content will not be available to anyone in the co-op session.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Become a Legend with the Hunting Pack DLC

We've prepared something perfect for the hunters out there. The Hunting Pack DLC adds a collection of beautifully adorned weapons and new outfits for your character, letting you express the wild spirit dwelling inside you. Hunt down legendary animals, forge your gear from their spoils, and enter the forest looking every inch the master hunter you were born to be.

Key Features

New attire

Choose between two outfits to clothe yourself and embrace your passion for hunting. This unique apparel is crafted from rare materials like fur, leather, and feathers taken from legendary animals. Blend into the forest with paw-like shoes and special headwear, or show your prestige in a fox scarf and gloves embellished with feathers.

Adorned weaponry

Carry a bow adorned with glossy feathers, a spear finished with vivid plumage, a knife wrapped in sturdy leather, and a crossbow accented with details made of scales. Every piece is shaped from a hard-won trophy, turning each hunt into something you'll want by your side on every trip.

How It Works

The DLC content is available immediately after purchase. To obtain new goods (outfits and weapons), you will have to hunt legendary animals coming with the Wild Game update and then craft new items.

When playing co-op, everyone in the session will gain access to the DLC content, provided that the host has the pack installed. Please note that if the host does not own the DLC, the content will not be available to anyone in the co-op session.
